findings: B1: the messaging-notifications row seeds one role and two accounts. The brief seeds four accounts and presents four role rows (visitor, member, moderator, owner) because the companion's permission model cannot be exercised below that. Recorded as a judgment call in 00-decisions.md.
C1: a minority of the numbered entries under Core features state a data shape or a record's fields rather than a rule, and those carry no negative case. Every entry that states a rule does carry one.

C7: Core features runs about 40k characters and the joined six about 57k, far past the 2,500 and 9,000 slices run_rubric applies. The tasker instructed that the caps be ignored. Judged scoring does not depend on the brief reaching the judge, because every criterion carries its own facts under G52.

D2: the mention rule originally said a notice is sent when the mentioned member has 'no live session', which could be read as covering any account holding an issued bearer token. Found here and closed: the brief now defines a live session as an open connection to the account's event stream and states that an earlier token is not one.
D4: the single occurrence of the word grader in the brief is inside the Data model password paragraph the kit mandates verbatim. It names no external checker and locates nothing outside the app.

S2: 01-PRD.md lists 15 must-have features against the 6-10 band a companion-backed task is meant to hold. The companion specifies a two-surface product and the extra entries are real scope rather than padding, but the count is above the stated band.

S7: 06-implementation-plan.md names an exit condition for all 18 phases but carries no closing deploy-and-self-test phase. The document is authoring-side only and reaches no emitted section, so nothing downstream depends on it.
S5: the check predates the A5 number rule. 04-uiux-brief.md carries colour as family, tone and shade and motion as named moments rather than as literal values, which is what A5 now requires.
S10: the only placeholder-shaped string in the spec folder is 00-decisions.md quoting the companion's own token names while recording that each was replaced.

ARCH-002 and ARCH-003 are NOT-APPLICABLE: the base is pinned by the tag python:3.12-slim-bookworm and the file carries no image digest, so there is no manifest-list choice to make and no digest to trace.
DEP-017 is NOT-APPLICABLE: [metadata].language is python, so no JRE is owed in the final stage.

DEP-011 is NOT-APPLICABLE: the check is conditioned on [verifier].environment_mode = shared, and the bundle now declares separate, so the grader ships its own image built from tests/Dockerfile. The grader packages remain installed at the grader-0.22.0 pins, which is harmless and keeps the image usable either way.

BP-004: the Node setup script is fetched over https and piped to a shell with no checksum. No source supplies a checksum for it, which is the condition the check is written against, and the step is identical to the kit's own reference environment.
CMP-011: no sidecar publishes a host port. The only ports key is on main, which CMP-022 requires.
CMP-018: the one bind mount is the read-only postgres init script, which is configuration rather than provider state.
RC-01: 22/22 judgment-class checklist obligations claimed by a criterion; G39 reverse independently finds no unclaimed ui-class item.
RC-15: converged on cycle 3. Cycle 1 carried a type enum outside the closed set; cycle 2 rebuilt the dimension budget; cycle 3 re-anchored R11 to a surface the brief names.

The prompt declares no machine-readable check registry, so the receipt carries a run verdict rather than a scorecard. checklist_qc.py is green on structure, ids, citations and ledger arithmetic; the coverage join is green in both directions under G24 and G39.
BENCH-002 is NOT-APPLICABLE: this is a standard-tier task, so the trivial tier's resource set is not the one owed.
VERIF-007 is NOT-APPLICABLE: neither payments nor storage is declared, so there is no shared provider credential to carry.
TAX-006 is NOT-APPLICABLE: language is python rather than any.
TAX-008 is NOT-APPLICABLE: global archetype uniqueness cannot be decided from one bundle; the mint ledger owns it.
INST-007 is NOT-APPLICABLE: instruction.md is present, so the spec folder is not standing in as the brief.
SIGN-001, SIGN-002 and SIGN-003 are NOT-APPLICABLE: each is marked deprecated in the registry and superseded by SIGN-004, which passes because no signoff table is present.

TAX-003: the product carries a per-space role hierarchy, which the check associates with enterprise. sub_category stays solo_founder because the Task Order fixes the cell and the kit never rewrites an input, and because signup is open, which is the solo_founder shape. The hierarchy is a property of a membership rather than of an organisation.
